#!/bin/bash
# nhc_test_harness.sh -- test configs generated by nhc_gen.py with real NHC.
#
# Usage: nhc_test_harness.sh <build-dir> [--force]
#
# Checks, using fakes so no real hardware is needed:
#   1. each host gets the expected number of checks, per context
#   2. GPU count check passes with 8 GPUs and fails with 7
#   3. Xid check fails on a fatal Xid and passes on a benign one
#
# WARNING: checks with auto-fix flags (-S, mount fixes) really act, even with
# MARK_OFFLINE=0: they may start services and create directories. Run only in
# CI or a throwaway container. Refuses to run elsewhere unless --force is given.
#
# aCupOfTea NHC series, part 9. License: MIT.
set -uo pipefail

BUILD="${1:?usage: $0 <build-dir> [--force]}"
HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
MODULE="${MODULE:-$HERE/acme_arch.nhc}"
NHC_SRC="${NHC_SRC:-/tmp/nhc}"
NHC_VERSION="${NHC_VERSION:-1.5}"
WORK="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- expectations
# "<host> <context> <number of checks>". Update when cluster.yaml changes:
# a mismatch means a class gained or lost checks, or a node lost coverage.
EXPECTED="
cn100     nhc         15
cn500     nhc         15
gpu07     nhc         25
gpu31     nhc          4
login01   nhc         11
storage01 nhc          4
gpu07     nhc-epilog   8
gpu07     nhc-deep    26
"
GPU_HOST=gpu07          # a host in a GPU class
GPU_MODEL="NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3"
GPU_COUNT=8

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- safety guard
if [[ "${2:-}" != "--force" && -z "${CI:-}" && ! -f /.dockerenv && ! -f /run/.containerenv ]]; then
    echo "Refusing to run outside CI or a container (auto-fix checks have side effects)." >&2
    echo "Re-run with --force if this machine is disposable." >&2
    exit 2
fi
[[ $EUID -eq 0 ]] || { echo "Run as root (NHC checks expect it)." >&2; exit 2; }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- setup
if [[ ! -x "$NHC_SRC/nhc" ]]; then
    git clone -q --depth 1 --branch "$NHC_VERSION" https://github.com/mej/nhc.git "$NHC_SRC" || exit 2
fi
mkdir -p "$WORK/conf" /var/run/nhc
cp -r "$NHC_SRC/scripts" "$WORK/conf/"
cp "$MODULE" "$WORK/conf/scripts/"

for n in "$GPU_COUNT" "$(( GPU_COUNT - 1 ))"; do
    printf '#!/bin/bash\nfor i in $(seq %d); do echo "%s"; done\n' "$n" "$GPU_MODEL" > "$WORK/smi$n"
    chmod +x "$WORK/smi$n"
done
echo '[5012.3] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3b:00): 79, pid=4242, GPU has fallen off the bus.' > "$WORK/dmesg-bad"
echo '[7.1] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3b:00): 13, pid=1, Graphics Exception' > "$WORK/dmesg-ok"

nhc_run() {   # nhc_run <conf> <host> [VAR=value ...]
    local conf=$1 host=$2; shift 2
    NHC_CFG_CONFDIR="$WORK/conf" NHC_CFG_INCDIR="$WORK/conf/scripts" \
        "$NHC_SRC/nhc" -c "$conf" -m "$host" -l- -t 60 -a -v NHC_RM=none MARK_OFFLINE=0 "$@" 2>&1
}

PASS=0 FAIL=0
ok()  { echo "ok   - $*"; PASS=$(( PASS + 1 )); }
bad() { echo "FAIL - $*"; FAIL=$(( FAIL + 1 )); }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 1. coverage
while read -r host ctx want; do
    [[ -n "$host" ]] || continue
    got=$(nhc_run "$BUILD/$ctx.conf" "$host" | grep -m1 -oE 'of [0-9]+' | grep -oE '[0-9]+')
    got=${got:-0}
    if [[ "$got" == "$want" ]]; then ok "$host $ctx: $got checks"
    else bad "$host $ctx: $got checks, expected $want"; fi
done <<< "$EXPECTED"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 2. GPU count
out=$(nhc_run "$BUILD/nhc-epilog.conf" "$GPU_HOST" ARCH_NVSMI="$WORK/smi$GPU_COUNT")
if grep -q 'check_arch_gpu_count:' <<< "$out"; then bad "GPU count fails with $GPU_COUNT healthy GPUs"
else ok "GPU count passes with $GPU_COUNT GPUs"; fi

out=$(nhc_run "$BUILD/nhc-epilog.conf" "$GPU_HOST" ARCH_NVSMI="$WORK/smi$(( GPU_COUNT - 1 ))")
if grep -q 'failed:  check_arch_gpu_count' <<< "$out"; then ok "GPU count fails with one GPU missing"
else bad "GPU count does NOT fail with one GPU missing"; fi

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 3. Xid
for case in bad ok; do
    { echo "* || NHC_DMESG_CMD=( cat $WORK/dmesg-$case )"; cat "$BUILD/nhc-epilog.conf"; } > "$WORK/xid.conf"
    out=$(nhc_run "$WORK/xid.conf" "$GPU_HOST" ARCH_NVSMI="$WORK/smi$GPU_COUNT")
    if grep -q 'failed:  check_cmd_dmesg' <<< "$out"; then
        [[ $case == bad ]] && ok "Xid check fails on fatal Xid 79" || bad "Xid check fails on benign Xid 13"
    else
        [[ $case == ok ]] && ok "Xid check passes on benign Xid 13" || bad "Xid check does NOT fail on fatal Xid 79"
    fi
done

echo "# $PASS passed, $FAIL failed"
(( FAIL == 0 ))
